text: Some time after their young daughter Christine drowns at home, John and Laura Baxter [carry their grief to Venice|who_suffers|the grieving], where John is restoring an ancient church. Laura meets two elderly sisters, one of them blind yet [able to see Christine|trigger|strange signs and visions], who bring a message that John is in danger and must leave. He scoffs, but keeps glimpsing [a small figure in a red coat like the one Christine wore|images|clothes, jewellery and keepsakes], and one day sees Laura [passing in a funeral boat|images|graves, coffins and funerals] when she should be in England.
